```text
# PR #3900: Patch: a Plain text button on the Statistics page that shows each card, and the cards it references, as readable text

Closes #3887

## What changed

The Statistics page's Cards tab has a **Plain text** on/off button. With it on, every listed card prints as text instead of a face. The card breakdown also gets a **Reference cards** list. With it off, the page is as it was. This is presentation only (rule 7): the text comes from the face model and the public catalog, and no number is restated (rule 9).

- **The button.** `PlainTextButton` sits in the `.stats-options` row after "Show 95% ranges", in the Segmented's look with `aria-pressed` (R3324003). The device keeps the choice under its own key, `jackioh.plainText`. It never writes the Full-art cards setting or the Show card text key, and it touches no game.
- **Cards.** The Table, the Grid and the Tokens and Other created cards sections each print a card as a `PlainCard`:
  - its name (through `readerName`), cost, type and tags;
  - Attack and Health where it has them;
  - its whole rules text, drawn by `RulesText`;
  - its Radiant text under a "Radiant" label, with the Radiant type line only when it differs.
  
  The Coin is no catalog card, so its row keeps its name. The Grid cell becomes a wider cell with no 5:7 ratio.
- **The breakdown.** The details column shows the card's `PlainCard`. Below it, "Reference cards" lists every id in `refs` (R279), token or not, deduplicated, the card itself left out. Each entry has its own `PlainCard` and a "View … in the Almanac" link.
- **Spec.** I added `spec/rulings/R3887000.md`, `spec/pending/3887.md` and one sentence in §9.11's "Patches on `/stats`" bullet. I added three `zh-CN` keys. No `crates/` change and no catalog fragment: `classify` says Internal.

New files are `apps/web/src/stats/PlainText.tsx` and `plainText.css`. The CSS uses tokens only and sits in its own sheet, so the ratchets are untouched. The edits are in `stats.tsx`, `CreatedPanel.tsx` (an optional `plainCardOf` prop) and `testids.ts`.

| `cargo jackioh spec check` | ok (2149 rulings, 5460 proofs) |
| `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` | `Internal`, exit 0 |
| `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo fmt --check` | all ok |
| `vitest run --project web --changed origin/main …` (the harness's command) | 7556 passed, 1 failed |

The one failure is `src/together/FriendsButton.test.tsx` ("R3728001 the rail's Friends opens the drawer…"), which hit its 15 s timeout during a 15-minute run with 382 workers. Run alone, that file passes (35/35). It reads nothing this diff touches, so I take it as a load timeout. I have no link to the same check failing on `main`, so I'm not calling it pre-existing.

I did not look at the page in a browser. `/stats` renders empty without the E2E server, so I relied on the tests and the ratchets. A reviewer may want to look at the Grid's plain look: the cell has `padding: 0` and no border, as the existing grid-card rule sets.

## New tests

- Eight in `stats.test.tsx`:
  - the button's markup and place (it is not in the header);
  - Table rows as text, then off again;
  - the Grid, then off again;
  - a visit that opens already on;
  - Bob's Plan's breakdown, whose refs hold both tokens and non-tokens;
  - `core-095` (self ref left out) and `core-003` (no list);
  - the breakdown with the button off keeping its Tokens section;
  - the Chinese reader.
- One for the Created sections, where The Coin keeps its name.
- Two in `CreatedPanel.test.tsx`.
- I added `plainTextToggle` to the existing R3324003 test's list of pressed buttons.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **A separate button, not a three-way choice with Show card text.** The three-way choice would change the Almanac's shared button, which is out of scope. The ruling records the rejection.
- **The breakdown keeps its face.** The plain text goes in the details column, which is wide enough to read, and the face-based preview stays.
- **The Tokens section is hidden while the button is on.** The Reference cards list already holds the tokens, so they are not shown twice.
- **The Coin keeps its plain name.** It has no catalog entry.

- `void locale` sits inside `PlainCard`'s `useMemo`, so the faces rebuild on a language switch. The lint passes with it.
```
